latest_news.headline: Iranian assault sparks huge fire at Kuwait International Airport
latest_news.text: Iranian strikes caused a massive fire at Kuwait International Airport. Combined with earlier drone strike on airport fuel tank, civilian aviation infrastructure now severely damaged. Part of continued Iranian bombardment of Gulf states despite ceasefire talks.

latest_news.headline: US double-tap airstrikes kill 7 Iraqi PMF fighters in Anbar — Iraq grants PMF 'right to respond'
latest_news.text: US airstrikes hit Habbaniyah base in Anbar targeting PMF military healthcare clinic — 7 killed, 13 wounded. Second day of strikes at same base. Iraq PM Sudani summons US charge d'affaires, threatens UN Security Council complaint. PMF granted 'right to respond' to any attack. Major escalation on Iraq front.

latest_news.headline: Iran formalizes 5-point counterproposal: reparations, Hormuz sovereignty, security guarantees
latest_news.text: Iran's Press TV published full 5-point plan: (1) halt killing of officials, (2) guarantees no future war, (3) war reparations, (4) end hostilities, (5) Iran's sovereignty over Strait of Hormuz. Gap with US 15-point plan remains enormous — reparations and Hormuz sovereignty are non-starters for Washington.

latest_news.headline: AP-NORC poll: Most Americans say Iran war 'has gone too far'
latest_news.text: New AP-NORC poll shows majority of Americans believe US military action against Iran has gone too far. Many worried about affording gasoline. Trump approval holding but conflict becoming 'major political liability.' Key domestic pressure point on ceasefire timeline.

latest_news.headline: Gulf states tell UNHRC: Iranian attacks 'violation of sovereignty' — resolution passes demanding end to attacks
latest_news.text: UN Human Rights Council passes resolution demanding end to Iran's 'unprovoked attacks' on Gulf countries. Gulf states formally label Iranian strikes as violations of sovereignty. Diplomatic isolation of Iran deepening even as military conflict continues.

Pakistan quietly extending conditional ceasefire with Afghanistan to keep mediation channel open. de_escalation_watch: DE-ESCALATION WATCH (Day 27) — PARADOX: Iran publicly REJECTS US plan as 'maximalist and unreasonable' while IAEA head says Islamabad talks possible THIS WEEKEND. Both sides posturing before table: Iran demands reparations + Hormuz sovereignty (non-starters), US demands nuclear rollback + Hormuz reopening (non-starters for Iran). Pakistan playing both sides: brokering talks AND extending ceasefire with Afghanistan to maintain leverage. Israel undermining diplomacy by accelerating strikes — 'rushing to hit targets before ceasefire stops them' (NYT). AP-NORC: 60%+ Americans say war 'gone too far.' Key question: Is Iran's rejection theatrical opening position or genuine deadlock? The Islamabad window (Friday-Saturday) will answer it.
